vol.name: Red Sonja: She-Devil with a Sword

title: Red Sonja: She-Devil with a Sword #7
desc:
The play's the thing! Withing a Khorshemish theater a new version of events is acted out upon the stage - while Red Sonja remains on the run following the events of the Rising Sun.

The sword and sorcery epic by writer Rory McConville (King Spawn) and artist Pablo de Bonis continues, with cover artists Stuart Sayger, Lucio Parillo, Joseph Michael Linsner, Mike Rooth, and a stunning piece of Cosplay by Megan Random!
